primary_external_evidence.claim_used: RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS affects symbolic links in all pathname components, unlike final-component-only no-follow behavior; this supports treating ancestor symlinks as a distinct path-resolution security condition.
Path.absolute makes a path absolute without resolving symlinks, while Path.is_symlink identifies the specific path object as a symlink; therefore ancestor components require separate treatment.

counterevidence_and_limits: The current main repair closes the demonstrated static pre-existing ancestor-symlink redirect only.
Userspace path resolution checks do not prove absence of path-component swap/TOCTOU races between validation and later creation/replacement.
Rejecting all symlink-resolving configured state paths can reduce compatibility on intentionally symlinked state paths; that tradeoff is security-specific.
